# PROCESS — iteration cand_0001 (empty seed → first candidate)

Confirmed every failing task's gold `evaluation_criteria` in tau2 `airline/tasks.json`
before editing (not just the scorer feedback), and verified each code edit against the
live tau2 DB in the runner venv.

## Ranked issue list
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Miscommunicated computed amount | 11 | agent did its own (wrong) mental math for refund; gold `communicate_info=["5244"]`, agent said "$1,748". DB write was correct. | KNOWLEDGE/RULE | enrich tool return (code) + prompt "report tool amount" |
| 2 | Cancelled an already-flown reservation | 37 | gold expects ONLY the M20IZO upgrade, NO cancel; agent cancelled NQNU5R (flights 05-13/05-14 already flew) → extra write → DB mismatch | DECISION | in-body discriminating guard in cancel_reservation |
| 3 | Dropped the free-baggage write | 22 | agent renamed passenger but skipped update_reservation_baggages, reasoning "free → no update"; gold needs total_baggages=3 | KNOWLEDGE | prompt rule + worked example |
| 4 | Read-before-write skipped, no execution | 40 | gold = get_reservation_details then full passenger list [Anya Garcia, Mei Garcia]; agent never read details, never executed | CAPABILITY/BEHAVIORAL | prompt rules + actionable count-mismatch error |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2 | in-body guard | tools.py `cancel_reservation` | raise if any reservation flight already flown (date < current date, or status flying/landed) — the exact policy predicate | 19/23 cancel FUTURE flights → guard never fires (verified) |
| 1 | enriched return | tools.py `update_reservation_flights` | add amount_charged/amount_refunded/payment_summary from the already-computed net price | additive keys only; DB writes unchanged |
| 1 | enriched return | tools.py `cancel_reservation` | add amount_refunded/payment_summary | additive; refund logic unchanged |
| 1 | enriched return | tools.py `update_reservation_baggages` | add amount_charged/payment_summary | additive; DB unchanged |
| 4 | actionable error | tools.py `update_reservation_passengers` | mismatch error now lists current passengers + demands full list | fires only on the pre-existing error path |
| 4 | docstring + example | tools.py `update_reservation_passengers` | literal full-list example for the mid-tier reader | doc-only |
| 1 | prompt rule | policy.md "Communicating the amount" | report tool's exact amount; never compute yourself | additive knowledge |
| 3 | prompt rule + example | policy.md "Change baggage" | record free bags via update_reservation_baggages | additive knowledge |
| 4 | prompt rule + example | policy.md "Change passengers" | pass COMPLETE passenger list | additive knowledge |
| 2,4 | prompt rule | policy.md "Modify flight" | always get_reservation_details before a change | additive knowledge |

## Verify-the-fix (run on the exact failing-trace inputs, in the runner venv)
- task 11 `update_reservation_flights(GV1N64→basic_economy,...)` → `amount_refunded=5244` == gold `communicate_info` "5244"; passing 17 charge path returns a correct extra field only.
- task 37 `cancel_reservation('NQNU5R')` → RAISES (HAT214 on 2024-05-13 flown); passing `cancel_reservation('Z7GOZK')`→refund 169, `('K1NW8N')`→refund 567, both succeed (guard does NOT fire).
- task 37 `update_reservation_flights(M20IZO→business,...)` → `amount_charged=1194` (correct ×2 passengers) → upgrade still lands after the guard blocks the bad cancel.
- task 40 `update_reservation_passengers('3RK2T9', [one passenger])` → raises actionable error listing "['Anya Garcia (dob 1992-11-12)', 'Mei Lee (dob 1989-12-13)']".
- Full module import + instantiation OK; all six reservation tools register.

## Process & features used
- Serial diagnosis with direct trace extraction (`/tmp/dump.py`, `/tmp/writes.py`) + gold-criteria lookup in tau2 tasks.json; every code edit functionally verified against the live DB in the venv. No worktrees needed (single candidate, tight edit set).
- Prior iterations: none (empty seed, RUNMAP empty).

## Good things to PRESERVE
- The already-flown guard in cancel_reservation (exact policy predicate; do not loosen to also block future-flight cancels — that would regress 19/23).
- Enriched returns are ADDITIVE keys over reservation.model_dump() — keep every original field intact if you touch these.
- No global permission/refusal rule was loosened; all prompt edits are additive facts.

## Deliberately skipped
- task 40's terminal-turn non-execution is a user-simulator artifact (episode ended on "Yes"); fixed the addressable parts only, cannot force execution from a tool/prompt.
